PFPI

LLAMAS, ROUGHRIDERS WIN SIZZLIN’ WEEK 9 AT 14-1, AND LLAMAS TIE MANIACS FOR PFPI SEASON LEAD

Dick’s Roughriders and Tati’s Llamas share Week 9 honors with season-best 14-1 records to win one of the highest-scoring weeks in PFPI history. That vaulted the Llamas into a tie with Mom’s Maniacs for the overall season lead.

The league was a combined 0-for-4 on Unique Hit opportunities.

PFPI’s 23rd season of the modern era is now at halftime – nine weeks in and nine to go – in the long run for the Dad’s Dynamics Cup championship trophy.
